# EduMedia

> EduMedia provides interactive STEM simulations and virtual experiments for elementary and secondary education across multiple languages.

EduMedia offers a comprehensive platform of interactive science and math simulations designed to enhance student engagement and learning outcomes. The platform supports multiple languages (English, French, Spanish, German) and provides both free trials and subscription-based access to its extensive library of educational content.

## Key Topics

- Interactive simulations
- STEM education
- Science learning
- Math education

## Getting Started

- [Interactive Science and Math Simulations for STEM – EduMedia](https://www.edumedia.com/en): EduMedia homepage: interactive STEM simulations and virtual experiments
- [Discover EduMedia – EduMedia](https://www.edumedia.com/en/demo): Free trial and product demo for EduMedia interactive simulations
- [Subscription – EduMedia](https://www.edumedia.com/en/subscribe): EduMedia subscription plans for Elementary and Secondary education

## Multi-Language Platforms

- [Interactive Science and Math Simulations for STEM – EduMedia](https://junior.edumedia.com/en): EduMedia Junior: STEM interactive simulations for elementary-secondary
- [Animations et simulations interactives pour les sciences et les maths – EduMedia](https://www.edumedia.com/fr): EduMedia French homepage with interactive science and math resources
- [Simulaciones Interactivas de Ciencias y Matemáticas para STEM – EduMedia](https://www.edumedia.com/es): EduMedia Spanish homepage for STEM interactive simulations
- [Interaktive STEM-Simulationen für Wissenschaft und Mathematik – EduMedia](https://www.edumedia.com/de): EduMedia German homepage with interactive STEM educational content

## Life Science Simulations

- [Pond ecosystem (biocoenosis and biotope) – Interactive Science Simulations](https://www.edumedia.com/en/media/140-pond-ecosystem-biocoenosis-and-biotope): Interactive simulation on pond ecosystems, biocoenosis and biotope
- [Metamorphosis in the Butterfly – Interactive Science Simulations](https://www.edumedia.com/en/media/147-metamorphosis-in-the-butterfly): Interactive simulation of butterfly metamorphosis and life cycle stages
- [Wastewater treatment – Interactive Science Simulations for STEM](https://www.edumedia.com/en/media/173-wastewater-treatment): Interactive simulation of wastewater treatment processes and procedures

## Physics & Geometry Simulations

- [Horseshoe magnet – Interactive Science Simulations for STEM](https://www.edumedia.com/en/media/330-horseshoe-magnet): Interactive physics simulation demonstrating magnetic fields and poles
- [Motion of the center of mass – Interactive Science Simulations](https://www.edumedia.com/en/media/472-motion-of-the-center-of-mass): Interactive physics simulation on center of mass and rigid body motion
- [Plane sections – Interactive Science Simulations for STEM](https://www.edumedia.com/en/media/15-plane-sections): Interactive 3D geometry simulation on plane sections and cross-sections
- [Cinematograph – Interactive Science Simulations for STEM](https://www.edumedia.com/en/media/506-cinematograph): Interactive simulation of cinematograph technology and motion pictures

## Mathematics & Assessment Tools

- [Power function – Interactive Science Simulations for STEM](https://www.edumedia.com/en/media/932-power-function): Interactive math simulation exploring power functions and graphing
- [Milli micro nano – Interactive Science Simulations for STEM](https://www.edumedia.com/en/media/980-milli-micro-nano): Interactive simulation of metric prefixes and scientific notation
- [Quiz Weight and Mass – Interactive Science Simulations for STEM](https://www.edumedia.com/en/media/593-quiz-weight-and-mass): Interactive physics quiz assessing knowledge of weight and mass concepts
- [Translation (video) – Interactive Science Simulations for STEM](https://www.edumedia.com/en/media/838-translation-video): Video tutorial on geometric translation transformations and vectors
